findings.explanation: Both INV-1005 and REC-1005 explicitly reference PO-1005, but no purchase order document exists anywhere in this transaction's evidence, so the authorization for the 59,000 INR spend cannot be verified.

REC-1005 is dated 2026-07-18, three days before the invoice INV-1005 it references (2026-07-21), an illogical sequence suggesting either a misrecorded date or a receipt that does not actually correspond to this invoice.
